sourceConflictNote: The official OKCPS calendar page says the 2027–28 Academic Year Calendar is pending an HB3151 adjustment, and the linked PDF is visibly titled DRAFT. The bilingual draft also contains inconsistent summary totals: the English section lists 170 Student Days (41, 39, 46 and 44), while the Spanish section lists 168 (41, 39, 46 and 42). This page uses the English calendar grid and English Student Days row, labels all dates provisional, and requires review when OKCPS replaces or revises the draft.

calendarNotes: The 2027–28 schedule is a draft, not a final OKCPS calendar. It lists August 11 as Classes Begin and May 18 as the Last Day of Classes. Unlike 2026–27, the draft separately lists September 24 and February 18 as no-school Conference Days after the published parent-conference dates. Thanksgiving Break runs November 22–26; district offices close November 25–26. Winter Break runs December 20–January 2; offices close December 23–January 2, and January 3 is a combined Professional Development / Teacher Work Day. April 14 is a Snow Day (If Available), so its attendance status can change. The English summary lists 170 Student Days, while the Spanish summary lists 168. Recheck the district page before making nonrefundable plans.

calendarFaqs.a: No. The official calendar page says the 2027–28 Academic Year Calendar is pending an HB3151 adjustment, and the linked PDF is marked DRAFT. Every date on this page should be treated as provisional.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Oklahoma City Public Schools start in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar lists Wednesday, August 11, 2027, as Classes Begin. Recheck the official OKCPS page before making firm plans.

calendarFaqs.q: When do OKCPS students return after Winter Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs through January 2, followed by a Professional Development / Teacher Work Day on January 3. Quarter 3 and student classes resume Tuesday, January 4, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the no-school Conference Days in the OKCPS 2027–28 draft?
calendarFaqs.a: Friday, September 24, 2027, and Friday, February 18, 2028, are Conference Days with no school. Parent conferences are separately listed on September 21 and 23 and February 15 and 17.

calendarFaqs.q: How many Student Days are in the OKCPS 2027–28 draft?
calendarFaqs.a: The English summary shows 170 Student Days: 41, 39, 46 and 44 by quarter. The Spanish summary shows 168 because Quarter 4 is printed as 42; this page uses the English figures and flags the conflict.

calendarFaqs.q: Is April 14, 2028 a guaranteed day off in OKCPS?
calendarFaqs.a: No. April 14 is labeled Snow Day (If Available), so its status is conditional. This date is excluded from the one-time ICS until OKCPS confirms whether students attend.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for OKCPS in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar lists Thursday, May 18, 2028, as the Last Day of Classes. May 19 is a Record Day for staff. Recheck both dates if OKCPS revises the calendar.
